method: Wash the vegetables. Chop onion and peppers where listed; slice tomato where listed and keep raw meat preparation separate.
Beat the measured eggs in a clean bowl and set them aside while cooking the vegetables.
Heat all the measured olive oil in the frying pan. Add the tomato, spinach; cook until softened, with spinach wilted and excess liquid evaporated where listed.
Add the beaten eggs to the cooked vegetables and stir until fully set.
Stir in the listed flavour ingredients (40g reduced-sugar BBQ sauce), mixing powders and liquids evenly; heat any beans or mushrooms until steaming hot.

Heat the sandwich toaster. Spoon the cooked filling between the measured bread slices, spreading it evenly and keeping wetter ingredients away from the edges. Do not overfill; serve any remaining cooked filling alongside.
Toast for around 4–6 minutes, following the appliance guidance, until the bread is crisp and the filling is steaming hot in the centre. Rest for one minute before cutting.
Serve the toastie with any remaining measured filling. Nutrition includes the whole portion, including the side.
